description: Runs atakann's NVFP4 build of Tencent Hy4 flash (220B parameters, 11.3B active per token, text and image input; routed experts in NVFP4 with NVIDIA ModelOpt, Engram tables in FP8 and resident, 165 GB) with vLLM across two Sparks (tensor parallel 2 with expert parallel), following atakann's dgx-spark-recipes kit (MIT) on Tencent's official vllm/vllm-openai hy4-flash image pinned by digest. The kit's six Python files (GB10 attention sink on FlashInfer's SM120 sparse-MLA kernel, fp8_ds_mla KV on sliding-window MLA, ModelOpt NVFP4 expert loading, a DFly drafter that accepts an NVFP4 target) are built into the image. Settings: 262,144-token context, 4 concurrent requests, 8,192 batched tokens, a 6 GiB KV cache per Spark, GPU memory utilization 0.85, one image per prompt, the built-in DFly2 drafter with 5 draft tokens, hy_v4 tool-call and reasoning parsers. Thinking is on by default; send reasoning_effort no_think in chat_template_kwargs to turn it off. The first start autotunes kernels and takes about 10 minutes. The declared per-Spark peak is the creator's measured lowest free memory (12.5 GiB of 130,663,231,488 bytes) less the 2 GiB OS floor. Licences are information only: model under the Tencent Hy License 1.0, kit MIT.
title: Hy4 flash NVFP4 vLLM two Sparks (atakann)
